lines.text: Henning's prediction just came true, and I think it reshapes what we thought we knew — so far, Matthew's recovery holding at 52ms HRV alongside 20.2 lbs lost suggests glucose dynamics, not protein primacy, are driving his recovery architecture.

I think Matthew will keep deferring the lab draw as long as the symptom baseline stays uncollected — so far, 30 days of journal silence makes it nearly impossible to build that case, and I expect that gap, not protein, is what stalls clinical progress next.

lines.text: I was skeptical when Lisa called the recovery spike genuine architecture rather than noise, but today's 77 recovery score and HRV of 57 — so far — suggest she was right and Matthew's sleep structure is holding load, not just bouncing off a floor event.

James Okafor's protein hold deserves scrutiny — I was wrong about dinner disruption collapsing intake during the dark journal gap, and Matthew held his average intact, so I think the intake concern is weaker than James is framing it right now.
Does Matthew see the 28-day journal silence as a deliberate choice, or has it quietly become the path of least resistance — and I wonder if even he knows which one it is yet?
